source_name: Bank mobile app store listings (vendor/tech fingerprint)
why_relevant: App Store / Google Play listings for Slovenian bank apps expose the publisher entity, which is frequently the software vendor rather than the bank (e.g. white-label mobile banking supplied by HRC or another vendor), plus release cadence and version history. A reliable, low-cost way to fingerprint the digital-channel supplier for each bank.

source_name: Portal javnih naročil (Uradni list RS) — enarocanje.si
why_relevant: Statutory national publication point under ZJN-3 for all Slovenian procurement notices, including 'obvestilo o oddaji naročila' (contract award notices) from banks, SID banka, Banka Slovenije, ministries, FURS and UJP. Award notices carry named winners, contract values and dates — the most quantitative signal in the cell. Banka Slovenije explicitly states all its procurement documentation is published here.

source_name: e-JN — Informacijski sistem za elektronsko javno naročanje (ejn.gov.si)
why_relevant: The state e-procurement transaction system where tenders are actually run and bids submitted; publishes 'Aktualna javna naročila' (live tenders) and hosts the DJN guidance pages. Gives forward-looking pipeline (what public financial bodies are about to buy) ahead of award notices.

source_name: OPSI — Seznam aktualnih javnih naročil v informacijskem sistemu e-JN (open dataset)
why_relevant: Machine-readable open-data mirror of live e-JN tenders (contracting authority, tender name and code, publication number and date, submission deadline, bid opening, status) since April 2018 — the cleanest structured ingest path for the procurement route, avoiding portal scraping.

source_name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (EU notices, Slovenia filter)
why_relevant: EU-level publication of all above-threshold Slovenian notices, including contract award notices for banking, payment and IT services. Bilingual (sl/en) structured notices with CPV codes, values and awarded economic operators; the most automatable cross-border comparison layer and a way to catch notices whose Slovenian text is thin.

source_name: OpenTender / Open Contracting Data Registry — TED-derived EU procurement data
why_relevant: Third-party cleaned and normalised TED data in OCDS form, useful for historical backfill, buyer/supplier entity resolution and value time-series for Slovenian public financial bodies without re-parsing raw TED XML.

source_name: SID banka — Letna poročila (annual reports)
why_relevant: State-owned promotional/export bank; annual reports back to 2006 give balance sheet, lending programmes, IT and operating cost lines, and strategy for a bank that is itself a contracting authority under ZJN-3. Directly on-topic for the run's 'annual reports' and 'disclosures' topics.

source_name: SID banka — Novice / sporočila za javnost
why_relevant: Press release stream announcing new financing programmes, funding lines, partnerships with commercial banks and results — an early-warning feed that usually precedes the annual report by months.

source_name: SID banka — Informacije javnega značaja / katalog
why_relevant: ZDIJZ catalogue page — points to the bank's obligatory disclosures, contract/business transparency registers and the FOI request route. Pointer to documents not otherwise indexed, and the legal basis for requesting procurement detail.

source_name: SDH — Slovenski državni holding, dokumentno središče in letna poročila upravljanja
why_relevant: Manages the state's capital investments (11.2 bn EUR book value at end-2022) including stakes in banks and insurers. The 'Letno poročilo o upravljanju kapitalskih naložb RS in SDH' reports to the National Assembly and names each holding with valuation, dividends and performance targets — a direct read on state ownership in banking and on divestment intentions.

source_name: UJP JN Plačila — poročanje o plačilih iz javnega naročanja
why_relevant: Since 1 Jan 2023 every contracting authority must report monthly the payments actually executed under public procurement contracts, and publish the contracts, through this UJP portal. This converts award notices into realised spend — the strongest available evidence of what vendors are actually being paid by public financial bodies.

source_name: UJP — Uprava Republike Slovenije za javna plačila (institution hub)
why_relevant: The public sector's payment infrastructure operator (UJPnet, UJP eRačun e-invoicing, UJPlačam cashless payment points). It is both a large payments buyer and the operator of rails that private payment vendors interconnect with — its tenders and service announcements reveal the public-sector payments technology roadmap.

source_name: Erar (KPK) — public sector transaction transparency application
why_relevant: Anti-corruption commission application exposing transaction-level payments by public institutions, state-owned enterprises and municipalities — goods and services, consultancy/intellectual services, and (since Sept 2024) e-invoices of budget users and transfers abroad. Lets you quantify what any named payments/IT vendor is actually paid by public financial bodies, month by month.

source_name: Državna revizijska komisija (DKOM) — odločitve v postopkih pravnega varstva
why_relevant: Review-body decisions on challenged tenders expose the technical requirements, evaluation criteria, competing bidders and pricing disputes in far more detail than the award notice — e.g. a decision involving Banka Slovenije over IT equipment covering technical specs, delivery, training and installation. Also flags which vendors fight for which public financial accounts.

source_name: MJU Direktorat za javno naročanje — letna statistična poročila o oddanih javnih naročilih
why_relevant: Annual statistical report (statutory under ZJN-3/ZJNPOV) giving procurement share of GDP, procedure types, subject categories, e-procurement uptake, financing sources and supplier location/size. Provides the denominator and multi-year trend against which individual banking/payments awards can be sized.

source_name: Banka Slovenije — katalog informacij javnega značaja & publikacije
why_relevant: The central bank is itself a contracting authority; its FOI catalogue states that all procurement documentation is published on enarocanje.si, which pins the route for tracking central-bank IT, cash-handling and payment-system purchases. The publications and release-calendar pages also anchor payment-systems reporting (Žiro kliring, TARGET/STEP2 participation).

source_name: Računsko sodišče RS — revizijska poročila (Court of Audit)
why_relevant: Performance and compliance audits of state bodies frequently dissect exactly the IT/payments projects in scope — e.g. the audit of the DURS information-system renewal and consolidation of tax payment sub-accounts, and audits of customs IT for excise procedures. Audits give budgets, delays, vendor management failures and named contracts that never appear in the award notice alone.

source_name: FURS / Ministrstvo za finance — Finančna uprava RS (institutional & procurement footprint)
why_relevant: FURS is a very large public buyer of payment-collection, e-invoicing, fiscal-verification (davčno potrjevanje računov) and card-acceptance services, and its detailed descriptions of tax payment mechanics document the public payment rails (payments into UJP-managed sub-accounts at Banka Slovenije). Both a tender source and a domain-terminology source.

source_name: OPSI publisher page — Ministrstvo za finance / UJP datasets
why_relevant: Enumerates the machine-readable datasets published by the Ministry of Finance/UJP — the fastest way to discover structured public-payment and budget-user data (e-invoices, sub-accounts, payment flows) instead of guessing at endpoints.

source_name: JavniRazpisi.com — commercial tender aggregator (IT / programska oprema branch)
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator that categorises Slovenian tenders by sector and publishes derived market statistics (e.g. software contract counts and aggregate values by period). Useful as a cross-check and for sector taxonomy, but derived and partly paywalled — never a primary citation.

source_name: Forum Media — Portal Javna naročila / javni razpisi
why_relevant: Publisher-run procurement portal with practitioner commentary on ZJN-3 practice and tender listings; helpful for interpreting Slovenian procurement procedure vocabulary and for spotting notable tenders, not for primary data.

source_name: PISRS — Zakon o javnem naročanju (ZJN-3) and Zakon o plačilnih storitvah in sistemih
why_relevant: The legal register defines what must be published, when, and how contract value is computed for banking and financial services (fees, commissions, interest) — essential for interpreting award values correctly and for knowing which thresholds push a notice to TED. Also anchors the payment-services legal vocabulary.

source_name: e-uprava institution directory (registry of public-sector contracting authorities)
why_relevant: Directory of Slovenian public institutions with identifiers and contact/organisational detail; used to enumerate the full list of public-sector 'naročniki' in the finance domain so no contracting authority in the cell is missed.

source_name: ZBS – Članice (member directory of banks, savings banks and leasing companies)
why_relevant: Enumerates the population of Slovenian banks/savings banks (~15) and leasing companies (~12) — the seed list for all issuer-level A1 disclosure collection. Observed on fetch: members rendered as logos, apparently without per-member hyperlinks, so names may need OCR/alt-text extraction.

source_name: ZBS – Ustanovni akti in poročila (statutes and annual reports)
why_relevant: ZBS annual reports summarise the year's sector agenda, committee work and lobbying priorities; a compact yearly narrative of what the Slovenian banking industry cared about. A 2025 annual report PDF was surfaced in search.

source_name: ZBS – Podatki bančnega sektorja (banking sector data)
why_relevant: Association-compiled sector aggregates (balance-sheet, network, channel data) that complement supervisory statistics and are often published earlier or in more industry-friendly cuts.

source_name: ZBS – Statistični podatki lizing dejavnost (leasing statistics)
why_relevant: Leasing is the least-covered financing segment in SI public statistics; ZBS is effectively the only aggregator, and the leasing member list identifies captive finance arms of banks and OEMs.

source_name: ZBS – Standardi in priročniki (inter-bank standards and handbooks)
why_relevant: Inter-bank technical standards and handbooks reveal the operational plumbing (payment message formats, real-estate valuation standards, AML practice) that vendors must comply with — a strong indirect signal for payments/technology procurement.
